title: Normalized exact integral completion comparison
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme $T$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. For every finite $F\subset\Omega$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $\mathcal I_F^s(T)$ and $\mathcal I_F^p(T)$ be the framework and PBC integral full categories underlying [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $I_F$ be their exact integral identity identification, as in [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. Put $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,T}$, and for $E\subseteq L$ write $C_{L/E}(K)=K\otimes^L_{R_E}R_L$ for ordinary derived extension and $U_{L/E}$ for the strict quotient-tower extension [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Integral formulas below are written in the common full categories using $I_F$.
For every $E\subseteq L$, the actual quotient-map comparison $b_{L/E}=\chi_{L/E}:C_{L/E}\to U_{L/E}$ restricts, together with its inverse, to natural isomorphisms of these integral categories. Both restricted functors are exact with the specified shifts. The comparison and its inverse are exact natural isomorphisms, and for every $m\in\mathbf Z$,
$$\sigma^U_{m,K}b_{L/E,K[m]}=b_{L/E,K}[m]\sigma^C_{m,K},\qquad
\sigma^C_{m,K}b_{L/E,K[m]}^{-1}=b_{L/E,K}^{-1}[m]\sigma^U_{m,K}.$$
The ordinary coefficient-presentation transport sends every tensor generator to the same generator under the identity coefficient identifications. On any flat-term K-flat representative $P\to K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], the transported comparison into the strict cone has $n$th quotient coordinate $p\otimes s\mapsto p\otimes\bar s$, with $\bar s$ the actual image in $(\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^n)_T$, and zero shifted-product coordinate. Its derived localization equation uses the canonical resolving comparisons of [lem-pur-quotient-scalar-comparison-descent], independently of the representative. Thus its localization is the specified integral scalar lift required in [def-fd-coefficient-comparison-datum]. The specified cone shift is $(x,y)\mapsto(x,(-1)^m y)$ and carries the completion-map value $(c(z),0)$ to $(c(z),0)$, where $c$ is the quotient cocone. These assertions hold also for $E=L$, under ordinary tensor multiplication, with $b_{E/E}$ the natural completeness unit.

proof.text: Obtain eChain, eOrd, eStrict and the complete signed representative and comparison-shift property from [lem-weil-point-completed-scalar-shift]. Apply [lem-fd-ordinary-scalar-normalized-exact] to its ordinary counit normalization.

Intrinsic integral completeness implies legacy completeness by [lem-sf-derived-complete-legacy-comparison]. Choose an auxiliary finite-field datum of characteristic greater than l, so legacy completeness gives IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted. The finite-free theorem makes the actual completedScalarComparison invertible. Strict scalar extension preserves intrinsic constructibility; isomorphism closure transfers this to ordinary extension. Fullness restricts the actual comparison to b, without changing its hom components.

Use fully faithful descent of CommShift along the target full-subcategory inclusion for each restriction. Its compatibility equation is exactly the required inclusion normalization. Apply the faithful inclusion to the shift square of b; the two normalization equations, naturality of the target inclusion shift and the ambient comparison square prove it. The inverse square follows by cancellation. Exactness of ordinary extension restricts along the exact fully faithful inclusion, and exactness of strict extension follows from its shift-compatible isomorphism b.

Take the localization equation and the two chain coordinates from the unique normalized constructions of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Its identity specialization is the required multiplication and completeness-unit equation. Apply [lem-fd-coefficient-scalar-lift-normalization] for the final coefficient-presentation clause.

mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q45-75617d197 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item, every cited statement and Q14's handed-off old steps 1–3 in full. There are no new nodes. The statement and stmt_deps are identical to the node Q14 created, proof_deps equal the union of the step uses, and there is no cycle and no SGA source. The steps keep every old argument and do not compress any.
- Step 1: lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible says U preserves D^b_c. The finite-free comparison χ applies because D^b_c objects are derived complete, so C(K) lies in the category by isomorphism closure. The stratified characterization's hypotheses (T noetherian, finite-dimensional, ℓ invertible) are exactly the item's.
- Step 2: the generator transport a⊗x↦e_L(a)⊗x of def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport is fixed on generators after the identifications e_E, e_L.
- Step 3: the quotient descent lemma applies with R=R_E, S=R_L, B_n=(O_L/ϖ_L^n)_T; exact countable products of R_L-modules come from the pro-etale products lemma. The descended map is the same χ, and the datum is used only as a normalization.
- Step 4: the chain-shift equation for every m, descended by lem-weil-completed-scalar-shift-descent. The sign (−1)^m multiplies only the zero shifted coordinate. I accept the ordinary-side σ^C as the standard shift of the left-derived termwise functor.
- Step 5: the inverse equation follows by cancellation, and exactness of U by an isomorphism of image triangles, with the third square from naturality and m=1.
- Edge cases E=L (completeness unit), m≤0, empty T and ramified L/E all hold.
- Batch-5 flag: lem-weil-pbc-integral-coefficient-presentation-comparison reaches lem-pod-derived-exact-square-composition, a generic derived-functor pasting lemma (Stacks 05S7/014F). It is not part of the trace formula or Poincaré duality or their proofs, so I accept it.
- I accept the generic tool_uses. No existing node duplicates the item.
